official_authorities.label: Oregon Laws 1979, chapter 794 — 9% amendment and emergency clause

calculation.reason: Historical rates and all statutory calculation branches have not yet been fully modeled.

annual_rate.notes: Oregon Laws 1979, chapter 794, effective immediately on July 25, 1979, raised the general money-judgment rate from 6% to 9%. ORS 82.010(2) ordinarily runs simple interest from entry unless the judgment specifies another date or a contract provides otherwise. Post-entry interest also accrues on prejudgment interest accrued before entry and on attorney fees and costs entered in the judgment. A contract above 9% and qualifying medical-professional-negligence judgments follow separate statutory branches. Verify applicability; not legal advice.
